name: Yuki-iro no Karte ~Karte von Schnee~
original_name: 雪色のカルテ～Karte von Schnee～
source:
A small town in the mountains. Hero is a doctor who works there with a nurse. One day a girl affected by some incurable disease comes to this doctor after hearing about his prowess. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-march-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
山间的一个小镇。主人公是一名在那里与护士一起工作的医生。一天，一个患有某种不治之症的女孩在听说了他的医术后前来求诊。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-march-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
